name: Aisle 4 shopping corridor at the 'Kitchen Gadgets' shelf label (customer). extract.py read the product word 'Kitchen' as a KITCHEN service department, but the drawing shows no counter or prep enclosure here - it is the open dry-grocery run between the aisle 4 and aisle 5 shelf backs (free strip x=796-816, y=246-606), badged AISLE 4 at (807,581).

East perimeter aisle in front of the Tortilleria opening (customer). Between the Deli case run (ends y=320) and the Bakery case run (starts y=337) the drawing leaves a ~17 pt service mouth at x=969-1027; the derived auto:DELI/auto:BAKERY seal (bridge 12 pt = 24 pt closing) bridges that mouth shut and then condemns the CUSTOMER-side lane at x=948-966, y=332-346 as Deli prep floor. That lane is printed floor WEST of the case face at x=968 and it is the only through-route of the east lane: with it sealed, the Deli/Seafood frontage (960,320) is 34.6 m of walking from the Bakery frontage (960,352) 2.8 m away. Restores the lane only - x stops at 967, so the case face and the prep floor behind it stay sealed.

Open floor between the freestanding display islands in the east perimeter aisle (customer). The map draws six separate island fixtures down x=930-944 (four squares at y=213-225, 244-254, 272-283, 302-312 and two cross-shaped units at y=326-347, 360-380) with 1.06-1.41 m of shopper floor between them. The auto:SEAFOOD seal zone reaches 130 pt from (1007,221) with a 20 pt bridge (1.94 m closing), which spans those gaps and merges the six islands into one continuous 19 m wall - splitting the east perimeter aisle into two lanes that do not communicate between y=213 and y=386. The five orphaned floor patches (48/48/63/49/36 cells) are each below min_sz=100, so they were culled silently and never printed in the QA stats. Only free_raw floor is restored, so the island bodies stay obstacles.
